results.title: US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Live updates: Interest rates steady, Federal Reserve forecasts 1 rate cut in 2026
Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement

summary: Fed held rates steady at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 (8-4 split — most dissents since Oct 1992). Median projection: 1 cut in 2026. Inflation elevated due to global energy prices. Middle East uncertainty cited. Next FOMC meeting not yet confirmed.
